title: The Last Night of the Lighthouse Keeper

lines.say: For forty years, one man lit the lighthouse lamp.
lines.cap: For *forty years,* one man lit the lamp.

lines.say: Tonight, he climbs the stairs for the last time.
lines.cap: Tonight, he climbs for the *last time.*

lines.say: And down on the shore, the whole village lights a candle.
lines.cap: Down on the shore, the *whole village* lights a candle.
